entries.09cff6ee1d763cfc: This is a reportable segment that provides management support aimed at improving the productivity of small and medium-sized enterprises by promoting DX and AI in business operations. The company combines IT tool introduction support, human resource development support, marketing support and funding support such as subsidies and grants, and AKARI Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary, also helps sell the company's services. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,233 million.
entries.15c29bfdcdede15e: The group consists of Writeup Co., Ltd. and one consolidated subsidiary, AKARI Co., Ltd.
entries.1b8710d8b112cccc: Management support services for small and medium-sized enterprises
entries.1c5f5b64f3345c7f: A company that comprehensively supports the management of small and micro businesses through support for using subsidies and grants and support for introducing IT and AI.
entries.23134ae9cdbad5de: Customers are small and micro enterprises receiving management support, and regional financial institutions, large and mid-sized companies, and local governments that use J-System to support their own customers and acquire new customers.
entries.23666849a44c8f48: J-System (system for automatic diagnosis of subsidies and grants and requests for online applications)
entries.24e1e0f49785d4ae: The strategic focus is to broaden its revenue sources from its three core services, J-Consulting, J-System and JD Net, to new services in the AI field. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, orders for AI-field services expanded, while sales of its core services fell short of expectations and the performance of its consolidated subsidiary AKARI was sluggish, so revenue decreased for the group as a whole.
entries.2f3ac7edfc9659bc: Its strength is being able to propose both the introduction of DX and AI services and measures to secure funds to ease the financial burden of those services. Because it guides clients on the use of public support programs of the government and local governments in cooperation with professionals in each specialist field, it makes it easier for small and micro enterprises without spare funds to tackle management issues.
entries.308d3818f14ff3ed: This is a management consulting service that supports resolution of management issues through DX and AI in business operations, and securing the funds needed to advance DX and AI, from the perspectives of IT, human resources, marketing and subsidies and grants.
entries.4d7f566b1c64a93c: Through "J-System," which automatically diagnoses subsidies and grants, and "J-Consulting," a management consulting service, it provides integrated support for small and medium-sized enterprises in DX and AI adoption and securing funds.
entries.53fc89f6b3584824: This is a system that automatically diagnoses subsidies and grants that a company can use, and allows applications for them to be requested online directly. Regional financial institutions, large and mid-sized enterprises and local governments that have many small and micro enterprises as customers adopt it and use it to support their own customers and acquire new customers. After the application request is made, it is handed over to J-Consul. The amount is not separately disclosed.
entries.55a3ba30b0653ecb: J-Consulting (management consulting for DX and AI adoption and securing funds)
entries.5cf9529bcbb6b8fa: JD Net (cooperative network for small and medium-sized enterprises)
entries.6347d86590ee3d29: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,529 million, down 11.9% from the previous year. The AI Solutions Business accounted for ¥3,233 million, and Other for ¥295 million.
entries.70bccda93d0ad80f: A category not included in the reportable segments, which includes the content business. In response to customers' marketing issues, it plans and provides Web marketing support measures such as email marketing support, social media activation support and content production, and its main customers are large and mid-sized companies. Besides direct transactions, it also conducts indirect transactions through advertising agencies. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥295 million.

entries.f47642f5160c6dd1: Based on its philosophy "Make every small and medium-sized enterprise in the country profitable," it states that it will deliver comprehensive management support using internet-related technologies. In the AI Solutions Business, building on the track record of its core services, it states that it will develop and provide new management support services that cover, end to end, from human resource development to business automation and operational establishment, centered on five areas: AI utilization training, AI agent packages, AI SaaS, AI operation outsourcing (BPO), and AI development support.
